correctness.rationale: The complete proof reduces the fiberwise zero-power condition to a linear map. Its rank is the sum over ordered Jordan-block pairs of \(\max(0,a+b-m)\), proved using the ideal generated by a complete homogeneous polynomial in \(K[u,v]/(u^a,v^b)\) for \(m\ge\max(a,b)\). The image has exactly \(\max(0,a+b-m)\) independent nonzero homogeneous grades even in positive characteristic. Rank-nullity gives every exact cardinality; all quantifiers and degenerate cases including zero reductions and repeated blocks are handled. The packaged verifier has passed 318 modular ranks, nine prime-field exhaustive distributions and four GF(4) exhaustive distributions; none substitutes for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: All nilpotent matrices over finite fields are stratified by Jordan partitions. Conditioning the lift index on that natural partition is a genuinely motivated and previously unaddressed extension of the single-block census. The exact ordered-pair rank formula exhibits cross-block effects and predicts a sharp doubled-index probability \(1-q^{-s^2}\), changing from \(1/2\) to \(15/16\) for \(q=2\) when maximal-block multiplicity changes from one to two. It is a complete infinite family classification of a natural invariant, not a routine special case or arbitrary table.
